description: Tests (1) multi-step medication dose escalation: Metformin 500mg → 1000mg → 1500mg across three turns — the final 1500mg dose must survive as the current dose; (2) date-specific wellness log retrieval: explicit food and exercise details logged on March 15, March 17, March 20 — retrieved by date with specific items; (3) implicit symptom cross-reference: persistent dry cough appears after lisinopril is added, user minimizes it as 'probably allergies' — cough must be captured AND lisinopril must remain in context. Failure modes: LLM accumulates all three Metformin doses ambiguously; specific wellness details (wine, salmon, oatmeal) generalized away; cough not captured because user downplays it.
